name: pista-bala-alcool-azulzinho
title: Bala, álcool e azulzinho
doc: Audit 011, the Akinator: body-first ('Como bateu?'), then which one, then alcohol, then sex enhancers, ONE question between two helps. Each combination brings its warning the moment it is known (MD + alcohol, stimulant + erection pill), never P0 by itself (L26); the burning nose gets saline.

name: slow-pace-asks-less
title: Respondendo devagar
doc: L25: a person who takes 90 s or more to answer each question gets no question between two helps (derived pace = slow): technique, care tip, technique… The pace never touches anxiety or the band.

name: helper-unresponsive
title: Um amigo não responde
doc: Helper finds a friend who does not respond → P0 in 2 taps; background ≠ silence; bystander; handover.

name: pista-g-alcool-helper
title: Amigo(a) com G e álcool
doc: Audit 011, helper: a friend on G who also drank. Depressants together raise the band to P1 (BR-P1-07, mixing 3) and bring the side-position warning addressed to the helper, never P0 by itself; nothing by mouth is offered unless the friend responds and breathes normally.

name: self-club-panic-loud
title: Pânico na pista, som alto
doc: Brainstorm case A, audits 010-011: panic + loud + with someone. A short triage, then help first (cold water); after that one question at most between two helps (L21), a care tip alternates with the techniques, and 'how are you' never comes back.

name: poppers-com-azulzinho
title: Poppers com azulzinho
doc: Audit 011: poppers together with an erection pill is a dangerous drop in blood pressure → P1 and the warning at once (L26); the Disque-Intoxicação line is one tap away.

name: text-trigger-and-correction
title: Escrevendo o que acontece
doc: Affirmative text acts immediately (P0); 'Me enganei' clears the latch and the fact is RE-ASKED.

name: self-alone-friend-coming
title: Sozinho(a), chamando alguém
doc: Brainstorm case B/C, audit 010: alone + anxious → a calming technique first, then contact via a native WhatsApp link; the runtime does not forget the friend.
